data.description: The figure provides detailed information about a cement job performed in the original wellbore of Well 56-32. The job was conducted on February 11, 2021, at 9:30 PM. It includes primary job details such as volume and rate data for conditioning, cementing, and displacement phases. The slurry information specifies the density, yield, sacks, volume, and rate of the cement used (RC Therma Lite G1). Post-job information indicates that the job was successful with a yes response to the liner top test and provides comments on the procedures followed during the job.
